task: Prevent Native from moving nonprimitive field values when checker ownership authority is absent.
observation: The nested-field method probes generated a move from a shared receiver (`self.inner.frontier`) even though the exact RHS EST occurrence had no local-ownership requirement or fact under any program SpecId. Native previously fell through to ordinary expression rendering. The consumer now stops at that exact Member occurrence unless checker authority exists; a primitive Int field control still compiles and prints 3.
impact: Fail-closed lowering prevents Rust code generation from silently treating an unclassified nonprimitive field read as an owned transfer. The READ cases remain blocked until checker authority is published.
evidence: tmp/field_nested_new.moss and tmp/field_nested_reassigned.moss: both fail with MOSS_INTERNAL_INVARIANT nonprimitive field binding lacks checker ownership authority

tests/phase28/take_fixtures/take_vector_field.moss: this base fails earlier with MOSS_INTERNAL_INVARIANT Native statement EST handle is missing or invalid; take-path preservation is not verified on this base
read-only exact-node trace: RHS ExprId16 has checked type vector[int] but no local ownership fact/requirement under SpecIds 0, 1, or 2

resolution.summary: Native now fails closed on missing nonprimitive field ownership authority. Checker-side READ authority and a usable take fixture remain required for end-to-end controls.
